interpretation.weekly_summary: 本周研究集中于神经解码与脑机接口，特别关注基于EEG和fMRI的大脑信号解码。主题分布中，Evaluation/Benchmark（8篇）、HCI/Human-AI（8篇）和Robotics（7篇）最为突出，反映了该领域对评估基准、人机交互和机器人控制的重视。高频词包括'eeg'（31次）、'decoding'、'brain'等，凸显信号处理的核心地位。代表工作如EEGForceFusion（2607.24126v1）提出融合离散与连续表征的抓握力解码，fMRI2Face（2607.22302v1）从fMRI重建高分辨率动态人脸，以及Phoneme- vs. Character-Level Targets（2607.26751v1）利用状态空间模型提升皮层内脑到文本转换。主题共现分析显示，Evaluation与Robotics（4次共现）、HCI与Robotics（4次共现）紧密交叉，表明评估方法和交互设计正在共同推动机器人及解码应用。此外，多篇论文强调跨被试泛化和自监督学习，如Self-Supervised Consistency Enhanced Disentangled Learning（2607.24023v1）和Bayesian Complete-Pooling（2607.22980v1），为解决个体差异提供新思路。整体上，脑机接口的研究正在向更稳健、通用的方向演进。
interpretation.weekly_summary_note: 本周小结由 deepseek-v4-pro 生成。

papers.tldr: 针对脑机接口中神经漂移导致解码性能下降的问题，本文提出自监督一致性增强解耦学习框架SSCDL。该框架设计了一致性增强神经解码器（CND），通过教师-学生一致性约束与模拟扰动学习鲁棒表征；并采用互补解耦泛化机制（CDG），基于神经偏好理论解耦运动信号为速度、方向等参数，捕获多视角不变表征，显著提升跨日泛化能力，在实验中取得最优解码性能。

papers.title_zh: 对临床解码的脑电图基础模型进行压力测试：数据集身份与定向负控制
papers.evidence: 对脑电图基础模型进行临床解码基准测试直接满足脑解码需求
papers.tldr: 本研究对预训练脑电图（EEG）基础模型在临床解码中的迁移性与鲁棒性进行压力测试，通过负对照与数据集身份解码等严格控制，在五种临床任务和四个数据集上评估六个模型。发现模型表现受评估单元、数据划分、对照强度等影响显著，经典特征常优于预训练模型，仅跨受试癫痫检测显示提升，强调需谨慎解读EEG基础模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: fMRI2Face: A Full-HD fMRI-Video Dataset and Geometry-Guided Neural Decoding Framework for Dynamic Human Face Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: fMRI2Face：全高清 fMRI-视频数据集与几何引导的神经解码框架用于动态人脸重建
papers.evidence: 基于fMRI的脑活动动态人脸重建
papers.tldr: 针对fMRI动态人脸重建缺乏高清数据集及解码方法难以兼顾身份细节与动态表情的问题，本文提出首个全高清fMRI-视频数据集fMRI-Face与几何引导的神经解码框架fMRI2Face。该框架从脑信号中提取外观上下文与三维形变控制，通过神经视频扩散实现高保真重建，在重建质量、身份保持和运动一致性上大幅超越现有方法。

papers.title: A Cyclic Adaptation-Generalization Framework with Uncertainty-Guided Self-Paced Learning for Long-Term Brain-Machine Interfaces
papers.title_zh: 面向长期脑机接口的基于不确定性引导自步学习的循环自适应-泛化框架
papers.evidence: 不确定性引导的自定进度学习用于长期脑解码
papers.tldr: 针对脑机接口长期部署中因神经漂移导致解码性能下降的挑战，现有域适应或域泛化方法忽视细粒度子域分布漂移 的问题，本文提出UnSPC框架。该框架通过不确定性引导的自步伪标记机制迭代筛选可靠样本，并创新地循环集成域适应与域泛化，逐步缓解全局与子域漂移，在多个数据集上验证了有效性，为长期稳定BMI控制奠定基础。
papers.abstract: Brain-Machine Interfaces (BMIs), which link the brain to external devices, hold great potential in rehabilitation, human performance augmentation, and human-centered robotics. papers.title_zh: 运动想象脑电图跨被试分类中的贝叶斯完全池化
papers.evidence: 跨被试运动想象脑电分类
papers.tldr: 脑机接口分类常忽视预测概率校准问题，本研究在20个运动想象脑电图数据集上系统对比了贝叶斯完全池化模型与频率学基线的跨被试分类性能。通过荟萃分析发现，贝叶斯模型仅在可靠性上呈现统计显著但实际意义有限的改善，并增加了预测不确定性，而区分度等指标无显著差异，且计算能耗高出约13倍。由此表明完全池化实际收益有限，建议未来探索部分池化策略。

papers.title_zh: 通过文本条件变换控制嵌入空间
papers.evidence: 基于文本条件的CLIP嵌入变换
papers.tldr: 多模态嵌入（如CLIP）将高维语义压缩为单一向量，导致非主导属性（如颜色、风格）被抑制。本文提出文本条件化变换，通过自然语言描述生成仿射变换，直接操作视觉嵌入空间以显式强调指定属性，无需重新编码。该方法能同时学习多种属性，在属性检索和多属性组织任务上均达最优性能，推理成本近乎零，为嵌入空间控制提供了统一高效框架。
papers.abstract: Multimodal embedding spaces in models like CLIP enable powerful capabilities such as semantic similarity retrieval and cross-modal zero-shot classification. These embeddings compress high-level semantics into a single vector, which comes at the cost of primarily expressing a dominant semantics like main object while suppressing other important attributes su...

papers.title: Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception
papers.title_zh: 面向汉语语音产生与感知的脑电到文本解码的文本-音频联合对齐
papers.evidence: 脑电解码到文本，跨被试神经对齐
papers.tldr: 针对从头皮脑电图（EEG）解码中文语句面临的维度高、个体差异大、信噪比低等挑战，提出EEGAlign框架。该框架通过对比学习联合对齐文本（BGE-M3）与音频（wav2vec 2.0）特征，再经CTC解码，实现端到端的字符序列预测。在ChineseEEG-2数据集上，朗读和被动听EEG的101句封闭集分类准确率分别达82.37%和41.43%，为首个非侵入式大词汇中文语句解码工作。
papers.abstract: Decoding speech information directly from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) into text provides a potential non-invasive neural communication pathway for individuals with severe speech and motor impairments. Compared with invasive approaches such as electrocorticography, EEG is safer and more widely deployable, yet substantially more challenging to decode.T...

papers.title: Towards simultaneous decoding of kinetic and kinematic movement parameters during grasp and lift task by noninvasive brain imaging
papers.title_zh: 通过无创脑成像在手抓取与抬起任务中同时解码动力学与运动学运动参数
papers.evidence: 从EEG解码运动参数用于脑机接口
papers.tldr: 本研究针对脑机接口中同时解码多个运动和力学参数的挑战，提出偏最小二乘、多层感知机和注意力三种回归模型，从非侵入性脑电图信号中解码抓取与抬起任务的参数。在WAY EEG GAL数据集上，注意力模型在多参数解码中取得最佳性能（R²=0.8，延迟29.2毫秒），但单参数表现下降；多层感知机更一致但精度较低（R²=0.49）。结论表明注意力模型有潜力用于实时多命令脑机接口。
papers.abstract: Brain-machine interfaces (BMIs) can assist individuals with limited mobility, such as stroke survivors or amputees. One of the key challenges in developing BMIs is expanding their usability and control, which can be achieved by accurately decoding multiple kinematic and kinetic parameters. To address this, we propose three regression models: partial least s...

papers.title: Variational Low-rank Tensor Decomposition for Multisubject Spatiotemporal Data Analysis
papers.title_zh: 用于多被试时空数据分析的变分低秩张量分解
papers.evidence: 多被试时空张量分解用于fMRI
papers.tldr: 本研究针对多被试时空数据中共享与个体特异性结构建模的挑战，提出时空变分张量分解框架ST-VTD。该方法结合张量生成模型与LL1低秩空间先验和LSTM时间先验，并通过展开优化的摊销变分推断提高效率。采用组ICA预热策略进一步改善优化。在合成fMRI数据上，ST-VTD在潜在因子恢复上显著优于经典基准。
papers.abstract: Modeling shared and subject-specific structure in multisubject spatiotemporal data remains challenging, particularly in neuroimaging, where both spatial and temporal patterns exhibit rich variability across subjects. Existing matrix and tensor decompositions provide interpretable factorizations, but rely on fixed multilinear structures or coupling schemes t...

papers.title: A Hierarchical Validity-Audit Framework for Neural Mass Models in Simulation-Based Inference: From Observational Coverage to Mechanistic Interpretation
papers.title_zh: 神经群体模型在基于模拟推断中的层级有效性审计框架：从观测覆盖到机制解释
papers.evidence: 验证群体水平的神经质量模型
papers.tldr: 基于模拟的推理虽能恢复神经质量模型的后验，但无法保证模型匹配真实数据、摘要统计量保留目标信息或参数可独立解释。为此提出分层效度审计框架NMM-SBI Audit，依次评估观测覆盖、信息损失及多轨联合后验一致性，并在癫痫和MMN数据集上验证，系统区分模型失配、摘要信息丢失、目标信息不足与参数补偿四种失败来源，为从模拟恢复过渡到可靠生理解释提供可扩展约束。
papers.abstract: Neural mass models describe population level neural activity using low-dimensional dynamical parameters and, through simulation-based inference, enable posterior estimation when explicit likelihoods are intractable, but good posterior recovery on simulated data does not guarantee that the model covers real observations, that summary statistics retain target...

papers.title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification
papers.title_zh: 用于多会话运动想象脑电信号分类的ATCNet-CIAM
papers.evidence: 运动想象脑电信号分类用于脑解码
papers.tldr: 针对运动想象脑电图在跨被试和跨会话解码中的不稳定性问题，本文提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，将轻量级通道集成注意力模块集成到注意力时间卷积网络中，增强通道空间特征表示。在BCI Competition IV-2a、2b及多日WBCIC-MI数据集上，标准、会话内和跨会话协议下的实验表明，模型显著提升了分类精度与鲁棒性，为多会话脑机接口提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract: Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decoding remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced attention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated at...

papers.title: Bayesian Feature Extraction using Gaussian and Diffused-gamma Priors for High Dimensional Spatio-Temporal Data
papers.title_zh: 基于高斯与扩散伽马先验的高维时空数据贝叶斯特征提取
papers.evidence: 多被试EEG数据上使用贝叶斯先验的结构稀疏性
papers.tldr: 针对高维时空数据的稀疏特征提取难题，本文提出一种贝叶斯框架，结合高斯与扩散伽马先验诱导结构化稀疏，采用Bregman散度构造似然并通过MCMC后验推断，设计基于后验样本的两阶段特征提取流程（假发现率控制与聚类），在脑电图分析中有效识别稀疏脑区活动，提升特征恢复和可解释性。方法适用于高维结构化问题，代码开源。
papers.abstract: High-dimensional data with sparse structure and spatio-temporal dependence arise in many scientific domains. We develop a Bayesian feature-extraction framework for spatio-temporal settings that employs Gaussian and Diffused-gamma priors to induce structured sparsity. The modeling framework specifies a general likelihood via Bregman divergence, enabling comp...

papers.title: Disentangling Semantic Attention from Structural Bias in the Attention Manifold
papers.title_zh: 在注意力流形中解耦语义注意力与结构偏置
papers.evidence: 解耦注意力流形中的结构偏差
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型注意力机制存在对无信息视觉标记的结构性偏向，导致视觉语义稀释和幻觉。现有方法效率低且孤立处理。本文提出SPAR，一种免训练、即插即用的干预，通过显著性引导纯化结构噪声，并将注意力重分配至关键视觉区域，从而缓解文本偏向，恢复真实视觉对齐，且计算开销可忽略。
papers.abstract: The empirical success of attention mechanism in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often obscures its inherent, subtle flaws. Specifically, MLLMs consistently exhibit disproportionate attention toward certain semantically uninformative visual tokens, a phenomenon termed "register" or "Visual Attention Sinks." While existing inference intervention meth...

papers.title: MSBraM: A Multi-scale Self-supervised Brain Foundation Model for Hierarchical EEG Dynamics Learning
papers.title_zh: MSBraM：一种用于分层脑电动态学习的多尺度自监督大脑基础模型
papers.evidence: 用于EEG层次化表征的自监督脑基础模型
papers.tldr: 针对现有自监督脑电模型难以捕获多尺度时间动态的问题，本研究提出多尺度自监督脑基础模型MSBraM。该模型通过两阶段预训练，首先利用多尺度神经分词器将原始脑电信号离散化为不同时间粒度的语义码，再采用课程式多尺度掩码策略学习分层表示。在逾2400小时数据上预训练后，MSBraM在12个公开数据集的10项下游任务中取得最优表现，验证了显式建模多尺度时序对脑电基础模型的关键作用。
papers.abstract: Self-supervised foundation models have recently shown strong potential for electroencephalogram (EEG)-based analysis. However, existing approaches struggle to capture the inherently multi-scale temporal structure of EEG signals, where local neural patterns and long-range dependencies jointly encode task-relevant information. This limitation hampers cross-sc...

papers.title: PIcsC: Partitioning-Induced Covariate Shift Correction
papers.title_zh: PIcsC: 划分诱导的协变量偏移校正
papers.evidence: 使用Fisher信息正则化校正分布偏移
papers.tldr: 数据分区（如交叉验证、联邦学习）往往引入协变量偏移，导致模型选择和参数估计偏差。本文提出PIcsC，一种基于Fisher信息矩阵的正则化框架，通过计算分区与参考分布的偏移统计量作为正则化项，仅需梯度统计量而无需原始数据。引入条件自适应机制仅在偏移显著时激活正则化。在40多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分批、折叠和联邦场景下有效减轻性能退化，提升模型鲁棒性。
papers.abstract: Covariate shift across training-data partitions biases model selection and parameter estimation in cross-validation, lifelong learning, and federated learning. We propose \textit{Partition-Induced Covariate-shift Correction} (\texttt{PIcsC}), a Fisher information-based regularization framework that mitigates distribution mismatch between data partitions and...

papers.title: Transition-Related Potentials as Markers of Narrative Comprehension in Continuous EEG
papers.title_zh: 连续脑电图中的转换相关电位作为叙事理解的标志
papers.evidence: EEG过渡相关电位用于叙事理解解码
papers.tldr: 研究针对传统事件相关电位(ERP)依赖重复试次、脱离自然情境的局限，通过让被试观看短片并提取与剪辑切点对齐的“过渡相关电位”(TRPs)，发现其具有与经典ERP类似的时域结构并受叙事背景调制。进一步利用深度神经网络直接从连续脑电中检测切点相关响应，实现跨影片和被试组的泛化，重现了背景依赖效应。该方法为自然刺激下的半自动化EEG分析提供了新工具，有助于理解叙事理解等认知过程。
papers.abstract: Harnessing the potential of electroencephalography (EEG) for brain research is fundamentally limited by intrinsic noise and the diffuse projection of brain-generated activity over the scalp. The standard event-related potential (ERP) paradigm addresses this limitation by relying on repeated independent trials, albeit at the cost of moving away from naturali...

papers.title: XGRVFL-MV: Residual-Coupled Graph-Embedded Multi-View Random Vector Functional Link Network with FleXi Guardian Loss
papers.title_zh: XGRVFL-MV：残差耦合图嵌入多视角随机向量函数链网络与灵活守卫损失
papers.evidence: 多视图RVFL结合图嵌入和残差耦合
papers.tldr: 本文针对多视角分类中保留视角几何结构、抑制大残差影响及建模视角间关系的挑战，提出残差耦合图嵌入多视角随机向量函数链接网络（XGRVFL-MV）。该方法为各视角构建RVFL表示，利用局部Fisher判别权重建构内禀与惩罚图进行图嵌入，采用有界非对称FleXi Guardian损失处理残差，并引入残差耦合项促进视角间残差一致性，同时保留视角特定表示。优化问题通过无需求逆的Nesterov加速梯度下降求解。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，XGRVFL-MV取得了有竞争力的分类性能。
papers.abstract: Random Vector Functional Link (RVFL) networks provide an efficient randomized learning framework for classification. Existing multi-view RVFL methods utilize complementary information from multiple views. However, preserving view-specific geometric structure, limiting the influence of large prediction residuals, and modeling relationships between multiple v...

papers.title: AdaptICA: Data-Adaptive Transformation Learning for Independent Component Analysis
papers.title_zh: AdaptICA：面向独立成分分析的数据自适应变换学习
papers.evidence: 用于脑解码的EEG潜结构恢复的ICA方法
papers.tldr: 独立成分分析（ICA）假设数据遵守线性混合，但非线性预处理常破坏该假设。本文提出AdaptICA框架，基于互信息准则联合学习数据自适应的分组分量变换与解混矩阵，理论证明了变换估计的可辨识性、一致性和渐近正态性，以及联合强一致性。方法可自动选择变换，并在无需调整时退化为标准ICA，仿真和应用显示了其优越性。
papers.abstract: Independent component analysis (ICA) is widely used to recover latent structure from signal and imaging data, but standard ICA assumes that the observed measurement scale preserves a linear mixing structure. This assumption may fail for features produced through nonlinear preprocessing, such as band-specific power in motor-imagery EEG. We propose AdaptICA,...

papers.title: An Attention-Based Framework for Alzheimers Disease Classification Using Resting-State fMRI
papers.title_zh: 基于注意力机制的阿尔茨海默病分类框架：利用静息态功能磁共振成像
papers.evidence: 使用注意力机制处理静息态fMRI进行脑解码
papers.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于注意力机制的深度学习框架，直接利用静息态功能磁共振成像的功能连接矩阵进行阿尔茨海默病分类。该方法将脑区视为标记，采用Transformer自注意力机制建模全脑长程功能依赖，自动学习判别性特征，无需手工特征工程。在ADNI纵向队列上，二元分类准确率达88.95%，AUC为0.90，证实了自注意力驱动功能连接建模在阿尔茨海默病检测中的有效性和可解释性。
papers.abstract: Accurate identification of Alzheimers disease (AD) using resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) remains challenging due to the high dimensionality, noise, and complex inter-regional dependencies inherent in functional brain connectivity, which limit the effectiveness of traditional approaches based on handcrafted connectivity features...

papers.title: From read-out geometry to in-silico stimulation: a distributed functional-connectivity signature of Alzheimer's disease
papers.title_zh: 从读出几何到计算机模拟刺激：阿尔茨海默病的分布式功能连接特征
papers.evidence: 跨被试fMRI功能连接的储层计算模型
papers.tldr: 本研究利用蓄水池计算模型重建阿尔茨海默病患者的个体化静息态功能连接，发现将病理动态修正至正常模板需要分布式、协调的多位点连接核改变，而非局灶靶点。基于疾病判别效应选择的个性化单点刺激可完全逆转分类，闭环控制能以更低剂量实现同等效果，揭示了阿尔茨海默病功能连接异常的分布式本质，并强调模型指导的个性化靶点选择对神经调控至关重要。
papers.abstract: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) is altered in Alzheimer's disease (AD), widely regarded as a distributed network process; whether its FC signature reduces to a few focal sites has not been tested causally, a question central to targeted neuromodulation. We fit subject-specific, cross-subject-identifiable reservoir-computing models that reconstruc...

papers.title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
papers.title_zh: 渐进编码的希尔伯特算子（HOPE）：深度网络学习表征解构的数学框架
papers.evidence: 解构深度网络表示以分析对齐
papers.tldr: 深度网络内部表示解构困难，传统压缩方法因尺度对称性和架构偏差受限。HOPE框架将压缩转入希尔伯特空间，把神经元建模为秩1算子，通过低秩投影和宏块驱逐统一剪枝、合并与多层结构压缩，实现无数据、无超参数的无偏架构决策，概念验证实验展示压缩与微调潜力。
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks encode complex representations, but deconstructing this internal knowledge remains a challenge. Given the link between learning and compression, network compression offers a promising lens to analyze this knowledge. However, standard compression heuristics often suffer from scale symmetries and architectural biases. To resolve these, we...

papers.title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
papers.title_zh: 基于 Conformer 掩码自编码器的新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病脑电图与心率变异性信号分类
papers.evidence: 使用自监督学习对新生儿脑病进行EEG分类
papers.tldr: 本文提出MAEConformer，一种结合Conformer架构与掩码自编码器的自监督学习框架，用于从大规模无标签EEG和HRV信号中学习表征。通过多分辨率短时傅里叶变换损失增强重建，预训练模型迁移至新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病严重程度分类，取得优异性能，证明了该框架在跨生理模态上的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-base...

papers.title: Projection Pursuit CPCANet for Domain Generalization
papers.title_zh: 投影寻踪CPCANet用于领域泛化
papers.evidence: 基于投影追踪的CPCANet通过学习公共主成分实现域不变表征，适用于多视图结构约束
papers.tldr: 针对领域泛化中CPCANet因小批量训练导致协方差估计秩亏的问题，本文提出投影寻踪CPCANet（PP-CPCANet），一种无协方差计算的框架。该方法在斯蒂弗尔流形上学习全局正交基，并通过凯莱变换与网络参数联合优化，同时引入对称破缺中位数投影寻踪离散度目标以提取共同主成分。在四个基准数据集上达到当前最优性能并保持训练稳定。
papers.abstract: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to learn representations robust to distribution shifts. Recent geometric alignment methods, such as CPCANet, extract domain-invariant structures through batch-wise Common Principal Component Analysis (CPCA). However, CPCANet suffers from rank-deficient covariance estimation due to the small-sample-size issue in mini-batch tra...

papers.title: Quantifying Event-Related (De)Synchronization Variability for Brain-Computer Interface: A Unified and Interpretable Framework
papers.title_zh: 量化事件相关(去)同步化变异性用于脑机接口：一个统一且可解释的框架
papers.evidence: 脑电解码变异性框架用于脑机接口
papers.tldr: 针对脑机接口中脑电信号变异性挑战，提出统一可解释框架，独立量化时间、空间和频率的变异性，通过运动想象数据集验证，发现低变异性与高分类性能相关，并揭示不同分类器对变异性的敏感性差异，为构建更鲁棒的BCI提供新途径。
papers.abstract: Objective: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) enable the control of external devices by decoding user intentions from electroencephalography (EEG). However, substantial EEG variability within and between users remains a major challenge. To better understand this variability, we propose interpretable metrics that independently quantify temporal, spatial, and f...

papers.title: Toward High-Fidelity 3D Point-Cloud Learning for Brain Folding Morphology Prediction Using Trans-Unet
papers.title_zh: 基于Trans-Unet的高保真三维点云学习用于脑折叠形态预测
papers.evidence: 从3D点云预测脑折叠形态
papers.tldr: 针对3D点云高保真学习中的挑战，Trans-Unet通过将点云转换为2D网格并结合CNN与自注意力机制，从有限元脑模型数据中学习精确特征，实现高分辨率脑折叠预测，在保真度和准确性上超越现有方法，同时显著降低计算成本。
papers.abstract: Learning high-fidelity point-cloud features in the 3D space poses significant challenges, including permutation invariance, lack of local context, difficulty in fine-grained surface reconstruction, and high computational cost. In this article, we propose Trans-Unet, a novel framework that addresses these issues by first tansforming 3D point-cloud data into...

papers.title: Unsupervised Graph Representation Learning with Complementary View Alignment
papers.title_zh: 基于互补视角对齐的无监督图表示学习
papers.evidence: 互补视图对齐用于图表示学习
papers.tldr: 针对无监督图表示学习在同质性假设下丢失高频信息的问题，本文提出AlignGAE模型。该模型作为MaskGAE的扩展，采用双编码器分别处理结构与属性信息，引入节点位置编码近似邻域身份分布（NID），并通过NID对齐策略和双重重建任务保留全频谱。在12个数据集上的实验表明，AlignGAE在异质图节点分类上性能提升最高达18.7%，同质图保持竞争力，建立了频率感知图表示学习新范式。
papers.abstract: Unsupervised graph representation learning aims to derive meaningful node embeddings by capturing both structural and attribute information without relying on labeled data. papers.title: What CLIP Knows but Cannot Say: Recovering Negation from Frozen Intermediate Features
papers.title_zh: CLIP知晓却无法言说：从冻结的中间特征中恢复否定信息
papers.evidence: 研究CLIP表征对齐与坍塌，可进行改进
papers.tldr: 对比视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）因表征坍缩现象对否定短语不敏感，将相反语义映射到相似嵌入。本文提出PeakPatch，一种事后修正方法，在文本编码器的组合句法峰值层提取否定信号，通过嵌入修正网络（ECN）和分数修正网络（SCN）将遗失的句法信息重新注入最终嵌入，全程冻结CLIP参数，仅增加3.5%的额外参数。该方法在否定理解基准NegBench上显著超越CLIP及各类微调基线，并展现出良好的跨任务和跨架构泛化能力。
papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP map semantically opposite phrases (e.g., "a dog" vs. "not a dog") to nearly identical embeddings, rendering them insensitive to negation. papers.title: When Language Models Meet NeuroGraphs: Exploring Enhanced Agentic LLM Framework Towards Brain Network Analysis
papers.title_zh: 当语言模型遇见神经图谱：探索面向脑网络分析的增强型智能体大语言模型框架
papers.evidence: 用于脑网络分析和连接组分类的LLM框架
papers.tldr: 脑网络分析对理解认知和神经疾病至关重要，但现有深度学习方法可解释性弱。大语言模型虽有潜力，直接应用受结构-语言鸿沟和知识局限的困扰。为此，提出BrainAgent，一种知识增强的代理LLM框架，将连接组分类转化为拓扑感知理解、外部检索、推理与反思的迭代过程，结合脑特定工具与案例。在四个fMRI数据集上，该方法持续提升多种LLM性能，并产生更全面、可验证的解释，为可解释脑网络分析开辟了实用路径。
papers.abstract: Brain network analysis is crucial for understanding cognition and neurological disorders, yet existing deep learning methods mainly treat connectome analysis as a graph-to-logit classification problem, offering limited explanatory reasoning.
